verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְהוֹעַדָּ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh mā·laḵ ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū wə·‘eś·rîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw yə·hō·w·‘ad·dān mî·rū·šā·lā·yim
verses.literal: Amaziah was twenty-five . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine . . . years His mother’s name was Jehoaddan she was from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: ERA Amazias da idade de vinte e cinco anos, quando começou a reinar, e reinou vinte e nove anos em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Joadã, de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה רַ֕ק לֹ֖א בְּלֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh raq lō bə·lê·ḇāḇ šā·lêm
verses.literal: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD but not wholeheartedly . . .
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era reto aos olhos do SENHOR, porém não com inteireza de coração.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַֽיַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֔יו הַמַּכִּ֖ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer ḥā·zə·qāh ham·mam·lā·ḵāh ‘ā·lāw way·ya·hă·rōḡ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ham·mak·kîm ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his grasp Amaziah executed the servants who had murdered his father the king
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu que, sendo-lhe o reino já confirmado, matou a seus servos que mataram o rei seu pai;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית כִּ֣י כַכָּת֣וּב בַּתּוֹרָ֡ה בְּסֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹא־ יָמ֨וּתוּ אָב֤וֹת עַל־ בָּנִים֙ וּבָנִים֙ לֹא־ יָמ֣וּתוּ עַל־ אָב֔וֹת כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ יָמֽוּתוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bə·nê·hem lō hê·mîṯ kî ḵak·kā·ṯūḇ bat·tō·w·rāh bə·sê·p̄er mō·šeh ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh lê·mōr lō- yā·mū·ṯū ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nîm lō- yā·mū·ṯū ‘al- ’ā·ḇō·wṯ kî ’îš bə·ḥeṭ·’ōw yā·mū·ṯū
verses.literal: Yet he did not put their sons to death but acted according to what is written in the Law in the Book of Moses where the LORD . . . commanded Fathers must not be put to death for their children and children must not be put to death for their fathers each is to die for his own sin
verses.literalPt: Porém não matou os filhos deles; mas fez segundo está escrito na lei, no livro de Moisés, como o SENHOR ordenou, dizendo: Não morrerão os pais pelos filhos, nem os filhos pelos pais; mas cada um morrerá pelo seu pecado.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֣ם לְבֵית־ אָב֗וֹת לְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וּלְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֔וֹת לְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֗ם לְמִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וַיִּמְצָאֵ֗ם שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף בָּחוּר֙ יוֹצֵ֣א צָבָ֔א אֹחֵ֖ז רֹ֥מַח וְצִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōṣ ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏêm lə·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·lə·śā·rê ham·mê·’ō·wṯ lə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min way·yip̄·qə·ḏêm lə·mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh way·yim·ṣā·’êm šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ bā·ḥūr yō·w·ṣê ṣā·ḇā ’ō·ḥêz rō·maḥ wə·ṣin·nāh
verses.literal: Then Amaziah gathered the people of Judah . . . and assigned them according to their families . . . to commanders of thousands and of hundreds And he numbered those twenty years of age . . . or older throughout Judah and Benjamin and found 300,000 . . . . . . chosen men able to serve in the army bearing the spear and shield
verses.literalPt: E Amazias reuniu a Judá e os pôs segundo as casas dos pais, sob capitães de milhares, e sob capitães de cem, por todo o Judá e Benjamim; e os contou, de vinte anos para cima, e achou deles trezentos mil escolhidos que podiam sair à guerra, e manejar lança e escudo.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂכֹּ֣ר מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֥אָה אֶ֛לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל בְּמֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־ כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·kōr mî·yiś·rā·’êl mê·’āh ’e·lep̄ gib·bō·wr ḥā·yil bə·mê·’āh ḵik·kar- kā·sep̄
verses.literal: He also hired 100,000 . . . mighty men of valor from Israel for a hundred talents of silver
verses.literalPt: Também de Israel tomou a soldo cem mil homens valentes, por cem talentos de prata.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים בָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַמֶּ֕לֶךְ אַל־ יָבֹ֥א עִמְּךָ֖ צְבָ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bā ’ê·lāw lê·mōr ham·me·leḵ ’al- yā·ḇō ‘im·mə·ḵā ṣə·ḇā yiś·rā·’êl kî ’ên Yah·weh ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl kōl bə·nê ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: But a man of God came to him and said O king do not let the army of Israel go with you for the LORD is not with Israel not with any of the Ephraimites . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém um homem de Deus veio a ele, dizendo: Ó rei, não deixes ir contigo o exército de Israel; porque o SENHOR não é com Israel, a saber com os filhos de Efraim.

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם־ בֹּ֣א אַתָּ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה חֲזַ֣ק לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה יַכְשִֽׁילְךָ֤ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־ כֹּ֛חַ בֵּאלֹהִ֖ים לַעְז֥וֹר וּלְהַכְשִֽׁיל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- bō ’at·tāh ‘ă·śêh ḥă·zaq lam·mil·ḥā·māh yaḵ·šî·lə·ḵā hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lip̄·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ kî yeš- kō·aḥ bê·lō·hîm la‘·zō·wr ū·lə·haḵ·šîl
verses.literal: Even if you go and fight bravely in battle God will overthrow you before the enemy for God has power to help and power to overthrow
verses.literalPt: Se quiseres ir, faze-o assim, esforça-te para a peleja. Deus, porém, te fará cair diante do inimigo; porque força há em Deus para ajudar e para fazer cair.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמַֽה־ לַּעֲשׂוֹת֙ לִמְאַ֣ת הַכִּכָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִגְד֣וּד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵ֚שׁ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לָ֥תֶת לְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū lə·’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mah- la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lim·’aṯ hak·kik·kār ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî liḡ·ḏūḏ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yêš Yah·weh lā·ṯeṯ lə·ḵā har·bêh miz·zeh
verses.literal: Amaziah asked the man of God What should I do about the hundred talents I have given to the troops of Israel And the man of God . . . replied The LORD is able to give you much more than this
verses.literalPt: E disse Amazias ao homem de Deus: Que se fará, pois, dos cem talentos de prata que dei às tropas de Israel? E disse o homem de Deus: Mais tem o SENHOR que te dar do que isso.

verses.original: וַיַּבְדִּילֵ֣ם אֲמַצְיָ֗הוּ לְהַגְּדוּד֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ מֵֽאֶפְרַ֔יִם לָלֶ֖כֶת לִמְקוֹמָ֑ם וַיִּ֨חַר אַפָּ֤ם מְאֹד֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וַיָּשׁ֥וּבוּ לִמְקוֹמָ֖ם בָּחֳרִי־ אָֽף׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yaḇ·dî·lêm ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū lə·hag·gə·ḏūḏ ’ă·šer- bā ’ê·lāw mê·’ep̄·ra·yim lā·le·ḵeṯ lim·qō·w·mām way·yi·ḥar ’ap·pām mə·’ōḏ bî·hū·ḏāh way·yā·šū·ḇū lim·qō·w·mām bā·ḥo·rî- ’āp̄
verses.literal: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home And they were furious . . . . . . with Judah and returned home in great anger
verses.literalPt: Então separou Amazias as tropas que lhe tinham vindo de Efraim, para que se fossem ao seu lugar; pelo que se acendeu a sua ira contra Judá, e voltaram para as suas casas ardendo em ira.

verses.original: וַאֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔ק וַיִּנְהַג֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ גֵּ֣יא הַמֶּ֑לַח וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ שֵׂעִ֖יר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·maṣ·yā·hū hiṯ·ḥaz·zaq way·yin·haḡ ’eṯ- ‘am·mōw way·yê·leḵ gê ham·me·laḥ way·yaḵ ’eṯ- bə·nê- śê·‘îr ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm
verses.literal: Amaziah, however summoned his strength and led his troops . . . to the Valley of Salt . . . where he struck down 10,000 . . . men of Seir
verses.literalPt: Esforçou-se, pois, Amazias, e conduziu o seu povo, e foi ao Vale do Sal; onde feriu a dez mil dos filhos de Seir.

verses.original: וַעֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים חַיִּ֗ים שָׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְבִיא֖וּם לְרֹ֣אשׁ הַסָּ֑לַע וַיַּשְׁלִיכ֛וּם מֵֽרֹאשׁ־ הַסֶּ֖לַע וְכֻלָּ֥ם נִבְקָֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ḥay·yîm šā·ḇū bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh way·ḇî·’ūm lə·rōš has·sā·la‘ way·yaš·lî·ḵūm mê·rōš- has·se·la‘ wə·ḵul·lām niḇ·qā·‘ū
verses.literal: and the army of Judah also captured 10,000 men . . . alive They took them to the top of a cliff . . . . . . and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces
verses.literalPt: Também os filhos de Judá prenderam vivos dez mil, e os levaram ao cume da rocha; e do mais alto da rocha os lançaram abaixo, e todos se despedaçaram.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י הַגְּד֗וּד אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֤יב אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מִלֶּ֤כֶת עִמּוֹ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיִּפְשְׁטוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִשֹּׁמְר֖וֹן וְעַד־ בֵּ֣ית חוֹר֑וֹן וַיַּכּ֤וּ מֵהֶם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖זּוּ בִּזָּ֥ה רַבָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê hag·gə·ḏūḏ ’ă·šer hê·šîḇ ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū mil·le·ḵeṯ ‘im·mōw lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·yip̄·šə·ṭū bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh miš·šō·mə·rō·wn wə·‘aḏ- bêṯ ḥō·w·rō·wn way·yak·kū mê·hem šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm way·yā·ḇōz·zū biz·zāh rab·bāh
verses.literal: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had dismissed from battle raided the cities of Judah from Samaria to Beth-horon They struck down . . . 3,000 people . . . and carried off a great deal of plunder
verses.literalPt: Porém os homens das tropas que Amazias despedira, para que não fossem com ele à peleja, deram sobre as cidades de Judá desde Samaria, até Bete-Horom; e feriram deles três mil, e saquearam grande despojo.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֨י ב֤וֹא אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵֽהַכּ֣וֹת אֶת־ אֲדוֹמִ֔ים וַיָּבֵ֗א אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֥ם ל֖וֹ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וְלִפְנֵיהֶ֥ם יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה וְלָהֶ֥ם יְקַטֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê ḇō·w ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū mê·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·w·mîm way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê bə·nê śê·‘îr way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏêm lōw lê·lō·hîm wə·lip̄·nê·hem yiš·ta·ḥă·weh wə·lā·hem yə·qaṭ·ṭêr
verses.literal: When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites he brought back the gods of the Seirites . . . set them up as his own gods bowed before them and burned sacrifices to them
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, depois que Amazias veio da matança dos edomitas e trouxe consigo os deuses dos filhos de Seir, tomou-os por seus deuses, e prostrou-se diante deles, e queimou-lhes incenso.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּאֲמַצְיָ֑הוּ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֵלָיו֙ נָבִ֔יא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ לָ֤מָּה דָרַ֙שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת־ עַמָּ֖ם מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh ba·’ă·maṣ·yā·hū way·yiš·laḥ ’ê·lāw nā·ḇî way·yō·mer lōw lām·māh ḏā·raš·tā ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘ām ’ă·šer lō- hiṣ·ṣî·lū ’eṯ- ‘am·mām mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against Amaziah and He sent him a prophet who said Why have you sought this people’s gods which could not deliver them from your hand
verses.literalPt: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Amazias, e mandou-lhe um profeta que lhe disse: Por que buscaste deuses deste povo, os quais não livraram o seu próprio povo da tua mão?

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בְּדַבְּר֣וֹ אֵלָ֗יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הַלְיוֹעֵ֤ץ לַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ נְתַנּ֔וּךָ חֲדַל־ לְךָ֖ לָ֣מָּה יַכּ֑וּךָ וַיֶּחְדַּ֣ל הַנָּבִ֗יא וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־ יָעַ֤ץ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְהַשְׁחִיתֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־ עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּ֔את וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ לַעֲצָתִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ḏab·bə·rōw ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer lōw hal·yō·w·‘êṣ lam·me·leḵ nə·ṯan·nū·ḵā ḥă·ḏal- lə·ḵā lām·māh yak·kū·ḵā way·yeḥ·dal han·nā·ḇî way·yō·mer yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- yā·‘aṣ ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·haš·ḥî·ṯe·ḵā kî- ‘ā·śî·ṯā zōṯ wə·lō šā·ma‘·tā la·‘ă·ṣā·ṯî
verses.literal: While he was still speaking the king asked Have we made you the counselor to the king Stop Why be struck down So the prophet stopped but he said I know that God has determined to destroy you because you have done this and have not heeded my advice
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, falando ele ao rei, este lhe respondeu: Puseram-te por conselheiro do rei? Cala-te! Por que haveria de ser ferido? Então parou o profeta, e disse: Bem vejo eu que já Deus deliberou destruir-te; porquanto fizeste isto, e não deste ouvidos ao meu conselho.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֗ץ אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶל־ יוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֧ז בֶּן־ יֵה֛וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לְךָ נִתְרָאֶ֥ה פָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yiš·laḥ ’el- yō·w·’āš ben- yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ben- yê·hū me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr lə·ḵå̄ niṯ·rā·’eh p̄ā·nîm
verses.literal: Then Amaziah king of Judah took counsel and sent word to the king of Israel Jehoash son of Jehoahaz the son of Jehu Come let us meet face to face he said
verses.literalPt: E, tendo tomado conselho, Amazias, rei de Judá, mandou dizer a Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, filho de Jeú, rei de Israel: Vem, vejamo-nos face a face.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח יוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־ אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַח֜וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֗וֹן שָׁ֠לַח אֶל־ הָאֶ֜רֶז אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּלְּבָנוֹן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנָֽה־ אֶת־ בִּתְּךָ֥ לִבְנִ֖י לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַֽתַּעֲבֹ֞ר חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן וַתִּרְמֹ֖ס אֶת־ הַחֽוֹחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yō·w·’āš me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr ha·ḥō·w·aḥ ’ă·šer bal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn šā·laḥ ’el- hā·’e·rez ’ă·šer bal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn lê·mōr tə·nāh- ’eṯ- bit·tə·ḵā liḇ·nî lə·’iš·šāh wat·ta·‘ă·ḇōr ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer bal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn wat·tir·mōs ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·w·aḥ
verses.literal: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon saying Give your daughter to my son in marriage Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle
verses.literalPt: Porém Jeoás, rei de Israel, mandou dizer a Amazias, rei de Judá: O cardo que estava no Líbano mandou dizer ao cedro que estava no Líbano: Dá tua filha por mulher a meu filho; porém os animais do campo, que estavam no Líbano passaram e pisaram o cardo.

verses.original: אָמַ֗רְתָּ הִנֵּ֤ה הִכִּ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ אֱד֔וֹם וּנְשָׂאֲךָ֥ לִבְּךָ֖ לְהַכְבִּ֑יד עַתָּה֙ שְׁבָ֣ה בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ לָ֤מָּה תִתְגָּרֶה֙ בְּרָעָ֔ה וְנָ֣פַלְתָּ֔ אַתָּ֖ה וִיהוּדָ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tā hin·nêh hik·kî·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ū·nə·śā·’ă·ḵā lib·bə·ḵā lə·haḵ·bîḏ ‘at·tāh šə·ḇāh bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā lām·māh ṯiṯ·gā·reh bə·rā·‘āh wə·nā·p̄al·tā ’at·tāh wî·hū·ḏāh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: You have said Look I have defeated Edom and your heart has become proud and boastful Now stay at home Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall you and Judah with you
verses.literalPt: Tu dizes: Eis que tenho ferido os edomitas; e elevou-se o teu coração, para te gloriares; agora, pois, fica em tua casa; por que te entremeterias no mal, para caíres tu e Judá contigo?

verses.original: וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֣ע אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ כִּ֤י מֵהָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ הִ֔יא לְמַ֖עַן תִּתָּ֣ם בְּיָ֑ד כִּ֣י דָֽרְשׁ֔וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū kî mê·hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hî lə·ma·‘an tit·tām bə·yāḏ kî ḏā·rə·šū ’êṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: But Amaziah would not listen for this had come from God in order to deliver them into the hand of Jehoash because they had sought the gods of Edom
verses.literalPt: Porém Amazias não lhe deu ouvidos, porque isto vinha de Deus, para entregá-los na mão dos seus inimigos; porquanto buscaram os deuses dos edomitas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל יוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּתְרָא֣וּ פָנִ֔ים ה֖וּא וַאֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּבֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al yō·w·’āš me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yiṯ·rā·’ū p̄ā·nîm hū wa·’ă·maṣ·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh bə·ḇêṯ še·meš ’ă·šer lî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: So Jehoash king of Israel advanced and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah
verses.literalPt: E Jeoás, rei de Israel, subiu; e ele e Amazias, rei de Judá, viram-se face a face em Bete-Semes, que está em Judá.

verses.original: וַיִּנָּ֥גֶף יְהוּדָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yin·nā·ḡep̄ yə·hū·ḏāh lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·nu·sū ’îš lə·’ō·hā·lāw
verses.literal: And Judah was routed before Israel and every man fled to his own home
verses.literalPt: E Judá foi ferido diante de Israel; e fugiu cada um para a sua tenda.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֗ז תָּפַ֛שׂ יוֹאָ֥שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וַיְבִיאֵ֙הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיִּפְרֹ֞ץ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם מִשַּׁ֤עַר אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ שַׁ֣עַר הַפּוֹנֶ֔ה אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ben- yō·w·’āš ben- yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz tā·p̄aś yō·w·’āš me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḇêṯ šā·meš way·ḇî·’ê·hū yə·rū·šā·lim way·yip̄·rōṣ bə·ḥō·w·maṯ yə·rū·šā·lim miš·ša·‘ar ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘aḏ- ša·‘ar hap·pō·w·neh ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ’am·māh
verses.literal: There at Beth-shemesh Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate a section of four hundred cubits
verses.literalPt: E Jeoás, rei de Israel, prendeu a Amazias, rei de Judá, filho de Joás, o filho de Jeoacaz, em Bete-Semes, e o trouxe a Jerusalém; e derrubou o muro de Jerusalém, desde a porta de Efraim até à porta da esquina, quatrocentos côvados.

verses.original: וְכָֽל־ הַזָּהָ֣ב וְהַכֶּ֡סֶף וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַ֠כֵּלִים הַנִּמְצְאִ֨ים בְּבֵית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם־ עֹבֵ֣ד אֱד֗וֹם וְאֶת־ אֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י הַתַּֽעֲרֻב֑וֹת וַיָּ֖שָׁב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl haz·zā·hāḇ wə·hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’êṯ kāl- hak·kê·lîm han·nim·ṣə·’îm bə·ḇêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘im- ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·’eṯ- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ bə·nê hat·ta·‘ă·ru·ḇō·wṯ way·yā·šāḇ šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the house of God with Obed-edom and in the treasuries of the royal palace as well as some hostages . . . Then he returned to Samaria
verses.literalPt: Também tomou todo o ouro, a prata, e todos os utensílios que se acharam na casa de Deus com Obede-Edom, e os tesouros da casa do rei, e os reféns; e voltou para Samaria.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֨י אֲמַצְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת יוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū ḇen- yō·w·’āš me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh ’a·ḥă·rê mō·wṯ yō·w·’āš ben- yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·mêš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh
verses.literal: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen . . . years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel
verses.literalPt: E viveu Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, depois da morte de Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, rei de Israel, quinze anos.

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הֲלֹא֙ הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·w·nîm hă·lō hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er mal·ḵê- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Amaziah from beginning to end are they not . . . written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Amazias, tanto os primeiros como os últimos, eis que, porventura, não estão escritos no livro dos reis de Judá e de Israel?

verses.original: וּמֵעֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁר־ סָ֤ר אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּקְשְׁר֨וּ עָלָ֥יו קֶ֛שֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּ֣נָס לָכִ֑ישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְח֤וּ אַחֲרָיו֙ לָכִ֔ישָׁה וַיְמִיתֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘êṯ ’ă·šer- sār ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū mê·’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh way·yiq·šə·rū ‘ā·lāw qe·šer bî·rū·šā·lim way·yā·nās lā·ḵî·šāh way·yiš·lə·ḥū ’a·ḥă·rāw lā·ḵî·šāh way·mî·ṯu·hū šām
verses.literal: From the time that Amaziah turned from following the LORD a conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish But men were sent after him to Lachish and they killed him there
verses.literalPt: E desde o tempo em que Amazias se desviou do SENHOR, conspiraram contra ele em Jerusalém, porém ele fugiu para Laquis; mas perseguiram-no até Laquis, e o mataram ali.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֖הוּ עַל־ הַסּוּסִ֑ים וַֽיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֥יר יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā·’u·hū ‘al- has·sū·sîm way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: They carried him back on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah
verses.literalPt: E trouxeram-no sobre cavalos e sepultaram-no com seus pais na cidade de Judá.
